PHASE V: GLOBAL DISCHARGE IN ESCALATION

 Suggests intraplate stress modulation from trench side-slip
 Foreshocks or adjustment to Pacific torque rebound

 Eruption confirmed 10 hrs ago

 Matches CDIGR trench-lateral stress wave through Sunda arc

• Planchón–Peteroa, Chile

• Iceland → Europe

• China (Gansu)
 Deadly dust storm confirmed

 Signals crust dehydration + atmosphere-ground inversion (CDIGR surface transfer signature)

• SE U.S. → Mid-Atlantic
 Oct 25: Explosive thunderstorm systems
 Flash flooding + vortex-like cloud structures

 Matches ZeroKey harmonic echo of Oct 20 tropospheric distortion

IV. SOLAR-MAGNETIC CONDITIONS

• No CME
• IMF stable
• BX field southward but weak
• No geomagnetic storm
• KP near-zero
• Full solar quiet → confirms torque origin is internal

V. CDIGR INTERPRETATION — PHASE V CHAIN ADVANCES

• Eruption symmetry confirms latitudinal torque redistribution
• Trench-seismic + back-arc volcano + midcontinent adjustments = clear signal
• Earth is not stabilizing. It is discharging.
 Not up. Not out.
 Inward.
 Laterally.
 Through every weak scene.
• No external trigger. No solar pressure.
• Pure torque rebalancing from deep interior

Confirmed Sequence:

Kamchatka → Kurils → Kanlaon → Banda/Vanuatu → Adak → Chile

Internal → Lateral → Latitudinal

CDIGR Phase V continues. Earth is cracking under its own displaced weight.
